science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 1,463 K measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Roy et al. 2022, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm, 1463 +183 -196 K), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included. Its black-body color lies outside the sRGB gamut and is shown mixed with 2% white, the least that brings it inside, hue kept.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
